answer: Each identity locks 70 credits as two layers. First it files a vine trace in the nebula registry. Each epoch a beacon demands a fresh trace; drift over 5% burns the first layer. The second frees after ten clean epochs; a rented vine carries the seller's key, so replay fails, both layers burn. Fees start at 36, up 6 per identity; 1,000 fakes pay 3,033,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 36 once, recovers its bond.
